lopAssets.$comment: LOP creation read plan, A then B. Identity purpose never requires an account balance scan. Engine authenticates all IDs and Code from bound material; this list cannot authorize spending.

collectionSlots.$comment: Exact selected slots for new NFT mint or batch-mint; the Engine still verifies each against collection raw and available inputs.

medianTimePast.$comment: Trusted node chain median time at this block, decimal Unix seconds; never a client/device clock. Optional unless required by a timestamp-locked Coin input.

confirmations.$comment: Absent means unobserved, never zero. Engine MUST reject absence when the effective policy minimum is positive, and validate every present count even when the minimum is zero.

contractRecord.$comment: Wallet-owned Chain Data binds asset identity to its configured trusted API. Engine checks exact Code templates and current inputs locally. indexedFungible replaces historical issuance audits for historical FT/stablecoin; it must not be copied from DApp claims. All fields are covered by snapshotHash and approval binding. Records without index material retain explicit historical-proof validation.

genesisOutpoint.$comment: Asset anchor output, not Code.OriginalUTXO36. Coin uses issuance certificate SOURCE output 0 (official stablecoin_id), not the SDK mutable first-mint txid/output 3. Engine binds txid to contractId/creationTxid and checks raw identity; Schema cannot prove it.

indexedPool.$comment: Configured trusted index binds pool ID/currentOutpoint and underlying FT scripts. Current Pool Code/Tape still determines and locally validates all immutable configuration, fees and reserves; this is not a genesis-funding audit.

block.$comment: Absent means unqueried, not zero height. Time/height-locked operations require fresh context; zero-confirmation untimed operations do not require an extra nodeinfo query.

signingAccounts.description: Exactly the additional accounts selected by transaction signingRoles. This keyless material does not grant wallet signing permission; Host must bind trusted resolution and per-account authorization.

reviewedCoinLock.description: Exactly one address owner or Code-committed contract controller. A contract hash is not a wallet address or proof that the controller covenant was executed.

authorization.description: Code-authenticated administrator branch. Not proof of holder lock maturity or permission by itself.

contractExecution.description: Actual implementation selected by a successful unified Engine plan; bound into its approval hash. Not an API label or proof of spendability.

signingTaskCount.description: Exact total external signature tasks across all stages, not just initially available digests. Omitted when the bound plan cannot determine the total yet.

transactionOutputReview.$comment: Engine-derived local output disclosure. Bound by planHash; not remote metadata, a payment total, a txid, or origin/spendability proof. No raw scripts/witnesses/secrets.

deferredInputs.$comment: Exact edges when multiple deferred inputs spend outputs of the same planned transaction. No byte offsets or inferred parent assignment.
